title: Start tracking

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: This folder is just a normal folder right now. Git isn't watching it.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Run `git init` to turn it into a git repository.

hints: How do you initialize an empty repository?
`git init` creates a hidden folder called `.git`.
recap: `git init` creates a hidden `.git` folder. Now git is tracking your files.

cheatSheet.summary: Create a new git repository in the current folder
